item.title: Sponsor Wells
item.description:
If you find my articles helpful or if they solved your problem, feel free to buy me a coffee. This will motivate me to continue creating content.

What is TWQR?

TWQR is a common QR Code payment standard launched by the Financial Information Service Co., linking the two major payment systems of banks and electronic payment institutions. It solves the problem of varying payment QR Code specifications on the market that are incompatible, and the confusion caused by stores displaying multiple QR Code stands for checkouts.

TWQR Scan Sponsorship

If you are browsing on a computer, please open mobile payment apps such as iPASS MONEY, JKOPay, PX Pay Plus, or Easy Wallet to scan the QR Code below for sponsorship (DO NOT use the camera App directly). If you do not have the above Apps, please refer to "Supported Mobile Payment Apps" below.

Mobile User Instructions:

  1. Take a screenshot of the QR Code on this webpage.
  2. Open any supported mobile payment App below.
  3. Click the "Scan" or "Payment" function in the App.
  4. Select "Read image from album" and select the screenshot you just took to make a payment.

Supported Mobile Payment Apps

This service is a common payment platform launched by the Financial Information Service Co. If you have the following mobile payment Apps, you can scan and pay:

Available Electronic Wallets / Linked Bank Accounts:

O'Pay JKOPay iPASS MONEY
PX Pay Plus Easy Wallet Plus Pay
icash Pay GAMA PAY ezPay
Taiwan Pay

Available Taiwan Pay (Bank App):

BOT Pay BOT Mobile + Land Bank Mobile
TBB Mobile TCB Bank First Bank Mobile
iLEO HNCB+ CHB Mobile
Mega Bank Sunny Bank COTA Bank Plus
Yuanta Bank DACARD E.SUN Wallet

Thank you for your support!
